name: degrain
what: motion-compensated temporal denoise (SMDegrain): averages each area with the same area of neighbouring frames, so real detail survives where plain blurring would not; never sharpens
when: the close-ups show fine speckle that changes on every frame (tape or film noise), not painted texture that stays put
softens: fine texture and film grain; at strong, faint detail in dark areas
tried_on: written from restoration practice; runs and passes the guard on a 15 s cut of an owner cartoon that does not show this defect (safe to try). Whether it helps on a source that has the defect is not shown yet
